name: Keep fitted
responsibility: Fits the whole reading, or the walkthrough step, until somebody pans or zooms; lands at once on the model a flight arrived at
description: A new model, variant or view fits the entire selected reading; each walkthrough step takes the camera back and fits its subjects; a new picture glides from the last reading, and leaving a presentation glides back. The model a flight arrived at is fitted at once, because the flight has already put the camera there.
